utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Registrar, could you call the case number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Mr. President. Case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecution versus Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. On behalf of my colleagues, I'd like to greet everyone present in the courtroom; Mr. Mundis, Defence counsel, the accused, and all those who are assisting us. I have two oral decisions to render. The first one will be read out in open session. This decision concerns the admission of a document that relates to the witness Ragib Mulahusic. The Chamber notes that P 09699, which is the statement of the witness Ragib Mulahusic, he appeared on the 20th of September, 2006, and we have forgotten to admit this document into evidence. As a result, the Chamber hereby admits into evidence P 09699. This was a document presented by the Prosecution and it is now being admitted, since this document has a certain probative value and a certain relevance. Before we move into private session, my attention has been drawn to the fact, by the legal officer - this is something I also noted - since the Prosecution filed a motion that concerned the demand of recognising certain facts that relate to the municipality of Stolac, this concerns the municipality of Stolac and its surroundings, the Defence counsel has not yet responded to this motion. The motion is, in fact, a letter forwarded to the Defence, and it would be good if the Defence responded with regard to the 100 facts that the Prosecution wants to have admitted. Certain are not in dispute; for example, if one says that Stolac is a town, that is not in dispute. I don't understand why the Defence has not yet responded. I would like all the Defence teams to examine this letter and its contents and to make a group response to this letter; thus we'll be able to save time. For the sake of the public, I said we're going to move into private session. Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 21st day of November, 2006, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.04 p.m.,
